21:["$","p",null,{"children":"The story has a shape, and the shape is a banana. Command Rusty to drive a gentle one-second arc,\nrun that same command a thousand times, and the cloud of final poses is not a tidy ellipse. It is\ncurved and lopsided, because a small rotational error early in the motion is multiplied by every\nmetre of translation that follows. That curve is not a rendering artifact and it is not something\nbetter hardware would fix. It is what motion uncertainty on a pose manifold actually looks like."}]
22:["$","p",null,{"children":"The modern punchline is that the banana is tame. Describe the same distribution in exponential\ncoordinates — the twist that takes the robot from where it was to where it is — and it becomes an\nordinary Gaussian, with a mean and a covariance and nothing curved about it. The banana was never\nthe distribution's fault. It was the coordinates'."}]
